description: Dispatch an async job that lists static lists, optionally filtered by names, and return {job_id, status} in milliseconds -- the listing itself runs in a background worker. Poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) for the finished result: path, columns, row_count, and truncated. Same page-cap shape as list_campaigns. Pages internally across Marketo's own 300-per-call vendor ceiling up to the effective row limit -- no next_page_token or continuation parameter exists on this verb. Defaults to 500 to avoid exhausting vendor rate limits and disk. To fetch more, pass acknowledge_default_limit_override=true together with an explicit row_limit (up to 5,000) -- both required together, refused rather than clamped above 5,000, and refused at DISPATCH time (before any job is created). Beyond the hard cap: no resumption, re-invoke with a narrower names filter. Prefer selecting on stable list IDs downstream over other fields when the goal is validation.
embedding_description: Find Marketo static lists -- curated, manually-maintained groups of leads, not triggered automation -- by exact list name, to discover a list_id before add/remove_leads_from_list changes membership. Async: a background job builds a workspace TSV while dispatch returns a job_id in milliseconds; retrieve it with check_marketo_job_status.

result_processor_customizations.action_label: Marketo static list export job dispatched
result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with job_id (pass to check_marketo_job_status to retrieve the finished export) and status (always 'queued' -- this verb never waits for the vendor listing).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the job was dispatched and give the job_id; tell the caller to poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) for the finished TSV handle (path, row_count, columns, truncated) with list names + ids. Do not claim the set of lists is complete from THIS verb's response -- it never carries list data.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Validate the static-list-listing request and dispatch a background job to list them and write them to a tab-separated file in the operator's workspace, up to an acknowledged override ceiling. This verb only validates and dispatches -- it never talks to Marketo directly.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: These are DISPATCH-time errors only -- caught before any vendor call is made, so no job was created. marketo.invalid_params: missing output_tsv_path, its parent directory does not exist, acknowledge_default_limit_override and row_limit were not given together, row_limit exceeded the 5,000 hard cap, or session_id/flow_id were missing from the calling context. marketo.export_path_refused: the path is not absolute, not a .tsv, or not contained under any operator-configured export_allowed_roots entry (an empty export_allowed_roots refuses every export by default). Vendor-side faults (marketo.auth_failed, marketo.permission_denied, marketo.rate_limited) can NOT surface here -- they only appear later, in check_marketo_job_status's error field, once the background worker actually calls Marketo.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For the override pair, pass BOTH acknowledge_default_limit_override=true and an explicit row_limit, or neither (for the 500-item default); a row_limit above 5,000 is refused outright, not clamped. marketo.export_path_refused: pass an ABSOLUTE path ending in .tsv under a configured workspace root. Once dispatch succeeds, poll check_marketo_job_status(job_id) -- if THAT reports an error, its guidance covers the vendor-side classes (auth, permission, rate limit); run check_setup for the exact missing Role permission since list enumeration's exact checkbox isn't publicly pinned.
